==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I create a button that helps to ground me in the dream when I press it. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The grounding button resembles an oval shaped black remote that fits in the palm of my hand with a single purple button on the middle of the remote. Whenever I press the button, I feel ASMR tingles all over my body in the dream world that appear visibly as harmless bolts of electricity.) A dwarf thief tries to sneak up behind me to rob me. (The dwarf thief resembled a dwarf with pointed ears, brown skin, black hair styled as a buzz cut, wearing a simple dark blue ninja outfit with a blue bandana covering the lower half of his face.) I scare away the thief by turning myself into a giant.
